comment: A new filter layer comes with a mask that hides nothing. An orange stroke on Layer 1, then the Layers docker's arrow and its Adjustment Layer row open the kind browser, Curves is picked and added, and its window applied. The Curves row shows a mask picture beside the layer's, and the stroke looks as the Curves layer makes it with no mask (shot 1). One undo takes the layer and its mask together (shot 2), and one redo brings both back (shot 3).
